name: Typing Test
description: Measure your typing speed and accuracy.

changelog.2.0.0: Now plain Python: nothing to install any more. Words per minute, accuracy marking and your best scores.
changelog.2.0.1: Now says what it can do (permissions: shown before you install, enforced while it runs), is listed in the new categories, and handles Ctrl+C and command-line arguments cleanly.
changelog.2.1.0: New: timed 15/30/60 second modes, live accuracy while you type, punctuation, code and quote texts, your own text from a file, and a progress graph ('typingtest stats').
